data: as in prereg/P11_cot.json (futures-only COT reports through 2026-10-13; registered price sources); n = (long - short) / open interest; flow u_t = n_t - n_{t-1}; only rows whose current and two previous reports are consecutive weeks

hypotheses.H1_primary: the 95% interval for the flow persistence r is narrower than 0.5 in at least 6 of 8 markets
hypotheses.H2: the first-stage F statistic is at least 10 in at least 6 of 8 markets
hypotheses.H3: the 95% interval for the flow response w excludes zero in at least 6 of 8 markets
hypotheses.report: IV estimates for the designated comparison class; OLS estimates for both classes

inference: moving-block bootstrap, 13-week blocks, 2,000 draws, 95% percentile intervals; first-stage F statistic for u_{t-1} on ret_{t-1} given ret_t
model: u_t = c + r u_{t-1} + w ret_t + e_t for the designated speculative class (leveraged funds or managed money); just-identified two-stage least squares with instruments (1, ret_{t-1}, ret_t)
pass_rule: the test passes if H1 holds; H2, H3 and the reports are given either way
question: Do the CFTC's class reports, read as class flows (weekly changes in class net positions), identify each class's flow response the way Proposition prop:tagged predicts: a per-class instrumental-variables regression with root-T precision?
relation: Paper 1 Proposition prop:tagged and Section 6.3; answers the request to test the tagged-flow contract (flows) rather than positions. Same COT data, markets, classes, prices and end date as the registered test P11_cot.
runs: run once; every run is counted in the unlock file
